verdict.rationale: Inngest is built to run background and scheduled jobs. The docs cover cron schedules with timezones, event and webhook triggers, durable steps with automatic retries, and long-running agents that suspend and resume without supervision. Community users corroborate this, reporting reliable use for scheduling, queues, triggers and background processing pipelines. Missing for 10: setting up automations is code-only through the SDK, with no evidence of no-code or agent-authored setup for an AI-native user.
